Case study · Strategy

Relaunching ADDA, a Desi eatery's comeback plan

Role
Paid Media & Content
Industry
Food & Beverage
Focus
Local relaunch

The situation

  • ~2,000 Facebook followers to reactivate, warm audience, not a cold start
  • 3.9★ across 979 Google reviews, sentiment cooled (taste, portion-for-price, service)
  • Listed “permanently closed”; posting off on Google & Facebook
  • Distinctive niche: contemporary Desi street food, Richardson TX

The strategy: reactivate the base, then widen the net

Awareness
Meta reach + video

“We're back” to the local radius & lookalikes of the base.

Consideration
Retargeting

Menu & dish creative to followers & video-viewers.

Conversion
Meta + Google

Offer ads + search capture for “desi food near me”.

Retention
Email flows

Welcome, win-back, weekly specials, repeat covers.

The plan, by channel

Meta
Wake the base, then convertReach announcement → retarget followers & engagers → offer ads. Audiences: the 2K followers, a 1% lookalike of past guests, 5-mile Richardson radius. Creative: “we're back” video, dish carousels, short Reels, vertical-first.
Google
Capture the intent already thereSearch for “desi / pakistani / indian food Richardson” + branded “ADDA”, plus Performance Max / Local for calls & directions. Google catches demand; Meta creates it.
Email
Turn attention into repeat visitsBuild the list via table QR & a relaunch incentive. Flows: welcome, win-back for lapsed guests, weekly specials. Owned audience = repeat covers at near-zero cost.

How I'd measure success

Did people see it?Reach and impressions
Did it grab them?Click-through rate and cost per click
Did it drive sales?Orders, cost per order, and ROAS (return on ad spend)
Did they come back?Email sign-ups, opens and clicks, revenue per email

Sales metrics like ROAS need order tracking set up before the ads go live. No results shown yet, campaign data pending.

Creative, real ADDA assets
